title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Mr Blue Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Mr Blue Nic Salt delivers a deep berry medley with sweet Blueberry, rich Blackberry and a hint of Raspberry. Smooth and full-flavoured, its a popular choice for fans of darker fruit profiles. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with refillable pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for quick, satisfying nicotine relief. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
